title: A predictive 14-gene signature and FLI1 inhibition overcome tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte dysfunction in triple-negative breast cancer.
authors: Jia, Meng; Jiang, Longwei; Han, Siqi; Zhang, Ying; He, Juanjuan; He, Guiyang; Wu, Chong; Zhang, Heng; Liang, Hongwei; Zen, Ke; Ao, Xudong; Jia, Shaochang; Liang, Junqing
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组和机器学习识别TIL反应性基因签名并靶向FLI1，但核心是肿瘤免疫治疗而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅涉及转录因子表达分析，无结合机制或AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive subtype lacking effective targeted therapies. Although immune checkpoint inhibitors such as pembrolizumab have improved clinical outcomes in a subset of patients, limited response rates and durability highlight the need for alternative strategies. Tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL)-based adoptive cell therapy represents a promising approach; however, the absence of reliable biomarkers for TIL functionality remains a major obstacle. In this study, we isolated TILs and autologous tumor cells from nine TNBC patients and classified TILs as reactive or non-reactive based on cytotoxic activity. Transcriptomic profiling combined with weighted gene co-expression network analysis and machine learning approaches identified a 14-gene signature that robustly distinguished reactive from non-reactive TILs. Transcription factor analysis revealed that Friend leukemia integration 1 (FLI1) regulates a large proportion of genes upregulated in non-reactive TILs. Notably, pharmacological inhibition of FLI1 using TK216 restored the cytotoxic function of non-reactive TILs and reduced expression of immunosuppressive genes. These findings identify a functional gene signature associated with TIL reactivity and suggest that targeting FLI1 may represent a strategy to enhance TIL-based immunotherapy in TNBC.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是一种侵袭性亚型，缺乏有效的靶向治疗。尽管免疫检查点抑制剂（如帕博利珠单抗）已改善部分患者的临床结局，但有限的应答率和持久性凸显了对替代策略的需求。基于肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TIL）的过继细胞疗法代表了一种有前景的方法；然而，缺乏可靠的TIL功能性生物标志物仍是主要障碍。在本研究中，我们从九名TNBC患者中分离了TIL和自体肿瘤细胞，并根据细胞毒性活性将TIL分类为反应性或非反应性。转录组学分析结合加权基因共表达网络分析和机器学习方法，鉴定出一个14基因特征，该特征能稳健地区分反应性与非反应性TIL。转录因子分析显示，Friend白血病整合1（FLI1）调控非反应性TIL中上调基因的很大一部分。值得注意的是，使用TK216对FLI1进行药理学抑制，恢复了非反应性TIL的细胞毒性功能，并降低了免疫抑制基因的表达。这些发现鉴定了一个与TIL反应性相关的功能性基因特征，并提示靶向FLI1可能代表一种增强TNBC中基于TIL的免疫治疗的策略。
